publicationBoundary.measuredTarballsPrecedeMeasurementAndSta: Fresh source/installed acceptance binds the recorded tarball identities and frozen runtime/schema/lock inputs. This receipt and subsequent status/support prose are publication metadata; the final whole distribution has a separate Gate A release-readiness obligation.

limits: Selected Linux ARM64 C17/C++20 finite CMake profile only.
Native diagnostic/test observations do not establish assertion correctness, production reachability, review truth or calibrated confidence.
Raw linked executable/shared-library bytes are not retained; their size/hash, ELF and DWARF observations are reconciled. Raw object/archive bytes are retained.
Pinned CRT bytes account for foreign debug metadata without hashing unavailable upstream source.
Selected SDK/header/runtime pins do not close the whole publisher, operating-system or license closure.
Fresh native processes do not establish independent AI host sessions.
